programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 1
programme.desc: Phil Serrell is joined by new Road Tripper Arusha Irvine on a jaunt around Herefordshire's antique shops in a 1976 Triumph Stag. Phil's joined by Daphne, his dog, while Roo finds a 300-year-old example of Georgian glass.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 2
programme.desc: Road Trip regular, Phil Serrell, plays a safe bet with a mahogany breakfast table, while Arusha 'Roo' Irvine's all at sea, gambling on an antique pond yacht.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 3
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell explore Yorkshire and Derbyshire. Along the way they dig up coal mining musical history, Phil attempts to buy a horse and Roo picks up another piece of her favorite glassware.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 4
programme.desc: Phil Serrell and Roo Irvine explore Oxfordshire. However, will the Stratford upon Avon auction supply comedy, tragedy or both? Plus, how the Chipping Norton Scouts re-invented British baseball and the Queen of 19th-century science.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 5
programme.desc: As Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell motor through the Cotswolds, Phil picks up a Victorian marmalade cutter, while Roo hopes a 16th-century bronze thimble will earn her a big profit. But who will be victorious at the final auction in Newent?

programme.desc: Después de divorciarse de sus respectivas parejas, María y Daniel se conocen en una tienda. Desde ese momento comienzan a encontrarse continuamente, pero ninguno está dispuesto a dar un paso adelante.

programme.title: Dime una mentira
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes se encuentran por casualidad y descubren que tienen la misma apariencia física, por lo cual deciden cambiar su identidad por un corto plazo. Sin embargo, el juego que al principio parecía inocente se sale de control.

programme.title: Ninette
programme.desc: Ninette Sánchez es una inteligente, divertida, graciosa y sobre todo preciosa muchacha parisina que trae loco a más de uno, entre ellos a Andrés, un joven español que cae rendido a sus múltiples encantos.

programme.title: Barrio
programme.desc: Javi, Manu y Rai son tres adolescentes que viven en un barrio periférico de Madrid que ven cómo el verano pasa monótono y aburrido en el suburbio. La falta de dinero, las chicas y sus ilusiones serán los temas que centren la vida de estos.

programme.title: Los años desnudos
programme.desc: Tras haber dado sus primeros pasos en el cabaret o la publicidad, tres atractivas treintañeras empiezan a hacer cine S, género que dominó en la época de la Transición.

programme.title: El séptimo día
programme.desc: El odio de dos familias ha llenando al pueblo de violencia. Isabel, a sus 15 años, buscará descubrir la verdad de una rivalidad alimentada por el rencor, que amenaza el futuro de toda su familia.

programme.title: Domingo de carnaval
programme.desc: Madrid, domingo de carnaval. Un vigilante nocturno encuentra el cadáver de una mujer, una rica y codiciosa prestamista que aparentemente ha sido asesinada. El principal sospechoso es un relojero que le debía mucho dinero.

programme.title: Antártida
programme.desc: Barcelona, 1985. María es una joven de 25 años cuyo estilo es caminar por el lado más salvaje de la vida, lo que la lleva a ser adicta a las drogas. Un buen día conoce a Rafael y su vida se torna aun más complicada.

programme.title: Antártida
programme.desc: Barcelona, 1985. María es una joven de 25 años cuyo estilo es caminar por el lado más salvaje de la vida, lo que la lleva a ser adicta a las drogas. Un buen día conoce a Rafael y su vida se torna aun más complicada.

programme.title: La Coquito
programme.desc: En el Madrid de 1920, la cantante cubana de cabaret Adela Portales La Coquito salta a la fama tras iniciar su carrera en La Habana. Ella interpreta canciones eróticas mientras su madre arregla enlaces con hombres por dinero.

programme.title: Tiempo de silencio
programme.desc: En el Madrid de los años 40, Pedro es un médico joven que trabaja en un centro oficial de investigación sobre el cáncer utilizando cobayas procedentes de NorteAmérica.

programme.title: La Chica de los anuncios
programme.desc: Yola es una chica de la provincia de Málaga que intenta triunfar en Madrid como modelo de publicidad. En la capital comparte habitación y sueños de triunfo con Bea, una aspirante a cantante. Pero sus aspiraciones son realmente complicadas.

programme.title: El solitario
programme.desc: Los delitos y detención en Portugal de Jaime Jimenez, autor de tres homicidios y decenas de atracos que cometía disfrazado y que pasara a la historia como los del atracador de bancos más buscado de España.

programme.title: El Palo
programme.desc: Es la historia de un atraco llevado a cabo por cuatro mujeres muy diferentes: una chica de la limpieza, una mujer de clase social alta venida a menos, una peluquera y una macarra.

programme.title: Los girasoles ciegos
programme.desc: Elena y su hijo Lorenzo mantienen las apariencias para ocultar los secretos de la familia: Elenita, la hija, se ha fugado embarazada con su novio y y su marido vive oculto en un hueco practicado en el dormitorio matrimonial.

programme.title: Las cosas del querer
programme.desc: Pepita se refugia en el sótano de un edificio durante los últimos bombardeos que sufre Madrid en la Guerra Civil. Allí conoce a Juan, un joven del que se enamora. El destino hace que acudan a una prueba y comiencen una gira.

programme.title: Carne de gallina
programme.desc: El fallecimiento de un minero asturiano prejubilado deja en una difícil situación económica a su familia.

programme.title: Cara de acelga
programme.desc: Antonio, un vagabundo ligero de equipaje y sin rumbo fijo, espera, en una carretera que alguien lo lleve a alguna parte. Así, es como acaba en un pueblo, donde se verá involucrado en un plan para robar una valiosa pintura en un convento.

programme.title: Bearn o la sala de las muñecas
programme.desc: En Mallorca, España, y tras la muerte de sus protectores, un hijo solitario, Juan Mayol, se dedica a reconstruir la abrumadora historia de su familia.

programme.title: Cándida
programme.desc: Cándida es una empleada doméstica que siempre ha soñado con tener su propia casita. Un día, gracias a un joven periodista, ella consigue un trozo de tierra para construir su hogar pero quizás deba renunciar a eso por estar con sus hijos.

programme.title: La dama boba
programme.desc: Dos hermanas de buena familia evaden de distintas formas la sociedad machista del siglo XVII. Una, a través de los libros, y la otra, haciéndose la tonta. Con la llegada de dos pretendientes surgirán en ellas la rivalidad y los celos.

programme.title: Tardes de Gaudí
programme.desc: En Barcelona, Cassandra, una traductora americana, es contratada por Frankie para localizar a su esposo, a su novia y a su hija. La mujer tendrá que descubrir el secreto mejor guardado antes de poder enfrentarse a su propio pasado.

programme.title: Cuatro noches de boda
programme.desc: En una iglesia de Madrid se celebran simultáneamente tres matrimonios, o mejor dicho, cuatro, porque veinte años atrás se casó aquí otra pareja, Miguel y Marta, que no tuvieron su viaje de novios. Ahora, deciden cumplir con la tradición.

programme.title: Cuatro noches de boda
programme.desc: En una iglesia de Madrid se celebran simultáneamente tres matrimonios, o mejor dicho, cuatro, porque veinte años atrás se casó aquí otra pareja, Miguel y Marta, que no tuvieron su viaje de novios. Ahora, deciden cumplir con la tradición.

programme.title: La Luna en botella
programme.desc: Zeta tiene un mes para entregar la novela que le han encargado y cada día busca inspiración en la extraña clientela que frecuenta el Café Rossignol. Todos desean cambiar de vida. Ha llegado el momento de intentar lo imposible.

programme.title: La marrana
programme.desc: Después de pasar tres años cautivo en Túnez, Bartolomé regresa a su tierra extremeña con la única ilusión de comer su manjar favorito: el cerdo. Por el camino se encuentra con un desertor que viaja acompañado por una marrana.

programme.title: Otra vuelta de tuerca
programme.desc: En el escenario de la costa vasca, un joven, tras abandonar el seminario, encuentra trabajo como profesor de los sobrinos del conde de Etxeberria, sin imaginar que el palacio guarda entre sus muros un inquietante misterio.

programme.title: El solitario
programme.desc: Los delitos y detención en Portugal de Jaime Jimenez, autor de tres homicidios y decenas de atracos que cometía disfrazado y que pasara a la historia como los del atracador de bancos más buscado de España.

programme.title: Los lobos de Washington
programme.desc: Dos amigos pretenden timar y vengarse de un antiguo colega, quien se vale de cualquier medio para escalar posiciones. Pero no es la única acción que se está tramando en esta jauría de lobos únicos en el mundo.

programme.title: Un Día con Sergio
programme.desc: Sergio, un galán cinematográfico en el declive de su carrera, se compromete a pasar 24 horas con la ganadora de un concurso femenino. La suerte recae en Tina, una chica del pequeño pueblo de Algarrobo de Mijares.

programme.title: Una pareja perfecta
programme.desc: Abbie y Robert son buenos amigos con muchas cosas en común. Harían la pareja perfecta, pero una cosa se los impide: Robert es homosexual. Pero un día de excesos acaba convirtiéndolos en padres, cambiando completamente su mundo.

programme.title: Fuera del cuerpo
programme.desc: La mala racha laboral y personal de Bruno podría cambiar cuando descubre que su vida es una película y él es sólo un personaje. No todo está perdido, y sus problemas se pueden solucionar.

programme.title: Alegre ma non troppo
programme.desc: Pablo, un joven homosexual, pretende ser músico, para lo cual procura ingresar en la joven Orquesta Nacional, en calidad de músico de trompa.

programme.title: Madregilda
programme.desc: En una taberna, varios amigos se reúnen para jugar cartas y recordar viejas campañas militares en África. Cada uno guarda un secreto sobre Gilda, una mujer dada por muerta, pero que reaparece para sorpresa de todos.

programme.title: Divinas palabras
programme.desc: Para huir de la pobreza, la esposa de un sacristán de aldea utiliza a un niño hidrocéfalo como atracción de feria. Eso la enfrenta a su cuñada, que tiene el mismo propósito, y a meterse en un mundo en que residen las más bajas pasiones.

programme.title: Colorín colorado
programme.desc: Manoli y Fernando son una pareja de ideales comunistas que desea vivir su amor libremente huyendo de cualquier convencionalismo burgués. Al principio el dúo rechaza la ayuda de los padres de ella, pero pronto empezarán a ceder.

programme.title: La luz prodigiosa
programme.desc: Joaquín es un joven andaluz que recoge a un hombre fusilado al que sus verdugos han dado por muerto. Por miedo a tenerlo en su casa, el chico lo deja en un asilo. Cuarenta años más tarde, Joaquín recupera la pista de ese hombre.

programme.desc: Serie que presenta la aclamada serie de historietas de Robert Kirkman con el mismo nombre donde un Sheriff se ve en un mundo lleno de Zombies.

programme.desc: Pedro y Vilma Picapiedra y sus amigos Pablo y Betty Mármol son dos fabulosas familias que sobreviven a la era de la prehistoria en la ciudad de Piedradura.

Pie Pequeño
programme.desc: Cuando un joven Yeti encuentra algo que creía que no existía: un humano. Estas noticias lo hacen famoso y ahora la comunidad Yeti se pregunta que hay allá.

programme.title: 112 en acción
programme.sub-title: Rosario Flores en Plaza Mayor de Cáceres
programme.desc: Unas 15.000 personas llenan la Plaza Mayor de Cáceres para asistir al concierto de Rosario Flores. Acompañamos a la Policía Local durante el dispositivo especial desplegado para garantizar la seguridad del evento, controlar los accesos y coordinarse con Policía Nacional y los servicios sanitarios. También acompañamos a la Guardia Civil en un control establecido en la A-5 para detectar drogas, armas y otros efectos ilícitos. Durante la inspección de un vehículo ocupado por tres personas, los agentes encuentran varias dosis de cocaína en la zona del copiloto. Por otro lado, los Bomberos reciben un aviso para acceder a una vivienda después de que resulte imposible contactar con su propietario. Los efectivos entran a través del balcón y encuentran al hombre fallecido. Poco después, tienen que regresar al domicilio ante la existencia de un posible riesgo biológico.

programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: The Future
programme.desc: An all-new documentary series and a true gift for engineering enthusiasts. Join CGTN's Yang Zhao on a captivating global journey, exploring a league of ambitious new engineering marvels. Uncover the extraordinary challenges and ingenious strategies behind these colossal structures. CGTN's award-winning Tech It Out studio embraces the popular short video format to innovate a brand-new style of engineering documentary and present "Architecture Intelligence," a nine-episode series. With our host Yang Zhao, we travel around the world and go beyond just witnessing mega-structures; we delve into the soul of each place we visit. We place architecture within the context of human lives, allowing it to serve as a lens through which we gain insights into a city, a nation and its culture.

programme.title: Innovation Has Its Way, Warmth Knows No Bounds
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a gala where robots take center stage? In Shanghai, a “Robot Gala” puts Chinese-made humanoid robots front and center — dancing, greeting customers, and even helping in classrooms. AI companions, from plush toys to holograms, are reshaping emotional connection in urban life. In Beijing, personalized tours led by multilingual guides help global travelers discover the Forbidden City and beyond. And in Thailand’s sugarcane fields, Chinese agricultural machinery is solving a labor crisis for local farmers. From cutting-edge technology to warm companionship, from cultural export to agricultural assistance, this episode of Meet China takes you to see how Chinese innovation unlocks a new picture of technology empowering life and cooperation promoting development.

programme.title: Dubai Chambers chairman: Chinese innovation is very welcome in Dubai
programme.desc: Dubai is already home to over 6,600 Chinese companies, but the emirate wants to see more. Sultan bin Saeed Al Mansoori, chairman of Dubai Chambers, said in an interview with CGTN that Dubai welcomes innovation and creativity from China and is open to more partnerships and cooperation.

programme.title: Live: Finding smart care and rehab solutions at 140th Canton Fair
programme.desc: The 140th China Import and Export Fair, also known as the Canton Fair, is underway in Guangzhou, south China, showcasing high-tech care and rehabilitation devices, from exoskeletons to stair-climbing wheelchairs. Millions of people worldwide need care and rehabilitation, and many can't afford it or reach it. CGTN's Zheng Songwu visits the fair's dedicated zone to test the latest devices and speak with international buyers about how China is helping meet that demand.

programme.title: Live: Canton Fair's 'hidden champions' - small firms, global reach
programme.desc: They're not household names, but global supply chains depend on them. At the 140th Canton Fair, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, managing director of the Rothenberger Group and a longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors - from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs are the backbone of China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

programme.title: 140th Canton Fair - machines built to work with humans
programme.desc: Seventy years ago, the Canton Fair featured Chinese tea, silk and handmade goods. Today, it's about robots. Join us to see dexterous robotic hands, exoskeletons and companion robots, and how AI works alongside humans.

programme.title: Xinjiang's role in Eurasia connectivity
programme.desc: From the bustling lanes of the world's largest bazaar in Urumqi to the humming logistics hubs at the region's 19 ports, Xinjiang is transforming its geographical advantage into economic strength. As China's gateway to the west, it now hosts a major network for opening-up, including the pioneering Pilot Free Trade Zone. This episode explores how cross-border trade, a web of China-Europe freight trains, and cultural exchanges are weaving Xinjiang into the very heart of the Belt and Road Initiative, making it a pivotal hub for continental connectivity.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: Inside China's Q3 Economy
programme.desc: China's economy expanded 4.6% in the first three quarters, with exports and high-tech manufacturing continuing to provide support, while consumption and industrial output picked up in September. What do the latest numbers reveal about China's growth momentum and economic transformation? Can renewed momentum and an improved structure help sustain growth in the months ahead? Join BizTalk as leading economists and experts take a closer look at China's Q3 economic performance, unpack the key signals behind the headline numbers, and assess the outlook for growth.

programme.title: Adidas CEO: Competition with Chinese brands makes us better
programme.desc: German sportswear giant Adidas has been in China for decades, but it's no longer just selling a European playbook. Its "In China, For China" model puts designers, creatives and supply chains directly into the bustle of the world's second largest economy - where competition is fierce and Chinese sportswear brands are stronger than ever. Recently in Shanghai, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu caught up with Adidas global CEO Bjørn Gulden to find out more.

programme.title: RAZOR: The Future of Fishing
programme.desc: The Earth will be home to nearly 10 billion people by 2050, and we need to figure out a sustainable way to feed them all. One solution could be fish farming. Seafood is already responsible for 17 percent of the world's protein intake, and aquaculture is the fastest growing food supply sector in the world. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi travels to the Arctic Circle, in Norway, where the company Salten Smolt is farming salmon on land while recycling up to 90 percent of its water. It uses a technology called Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), which is also being tested by Nord University on warm water fish like tilapia. Salten Smolt says the future of sustainable fish farming is both in tanks on land and technologically-advanced open water pens. Meanwhile on the island of Indre Haroya, the company Salmon Evolution is growing fish in tanks until harvest, using a Hybrid Flow-Through System (HFS) that recycles up to 65 % of the seawater it takes from the ocean. Salmon Evolution says that's a sweet spot that balances both sustainability and costs.

programme.title: RAZOR: Rewilding Bison
programme.desc: Once widespread across Europe, the European bison was driven to extinction in the wild by overhunting. Now, thanks to decades of conservation and reintroduction efforts, the species is making a comeback. In Romania's Tarcu Mountains, bison have returned after more than 200 years, with over 120 now roaming freely. RAZOR's Emma Keeling treks through the mountains to meet the team behind the rewilding project, jointly led by WWF and Rewilding Europe. The return of bison is benefiting more than 600 other species, from microorganisms to large carnivores, while creating new opportunities for local communities through ecotourism. How can bringing a species back from the brink help restore an entire ecosystem and build a more sustainable relationship between people and nature?

programme.title: China's Economy and the World: Exploring the 15th Five-Year Plan and global economic order shift
programme.desc: In this special series, "China's Economy and the World," expert Sławomir Majman, Vice President of the Polish Institute of Security and International Development and former President of the Polish Information and Foreign Investment Agency, explores China's 15th Five-Year Plan and the reshaping global economic order.

programme.title: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Hanggai brings Inner Mongolian grasslands to New York
programme.desc: You don't need to speak the language to be captivated by Hanggai's music. This Chinese folk-rock band blends powerful vocals, traditional instruments and rock energy into a sound all its own. This summer, Hanggai returns to Lincoln center, bringing the beautiful melodies of the Inner Mongolian Steppe to New York. The band members share their expectations, and the stories behind their music.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan's four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people's most important rituals: the coming of age ceremony.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China's most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang's First Peak - this time, he's all in.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China's ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China's most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China's most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as "China's First Lawn". Trace Xiamen's history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city's early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the "Island of Music" - the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living "World Architecture Museum". Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen's vibrant life.

programme.title: Crunch and Munch in Macao Ep.4
programme.desc: Feast on the stories behind Macao's iconic dishes and its people - One Country, Two Systems, endless flavors.

programme.title: Fearless Journey Ep.1
programme.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host "Uncle Hanzi" travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father's dedication, his daughter's passion, and his apprentices'enthusiasm - showcasing how this centuries - old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Chinese film director Wen Muye on food, war and longing for peace
programme.desc: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East, one of China's top-grossing films this summer, follows a Chinese restaurateur whose life is upended when war erupts around him. Ahead of its international debut this September, director Wen Muye spoke to CGTN about what inspired the film, and the message he hopes it carries beyond China.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of golden snub-nosed monkeys
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China's rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Fearless Journey Ep.1
programme.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host "Uncle Hanzi" travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father's dedication, his daughter's passion, and his apprentices'enthusiasm - showcasing how this centuries - old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Chinese film director Wen Muye on food, war and longing for peace
programme.desc: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East, one of China's top-grossing films this summer, follows a Chinese restaurateur whose life is upended when war erupts around him. Ahead of its international debut this September, director Wen Muye spoke to CGTN about what inspired the film, and the message he hopes it carries beyond China.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of golden snub-nosed monkeys
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China's rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan's four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people's most important rituals: the coming of age ceremony.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China's most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang's First Peak - this time, he's all in.

programme.title: Hombres de élite
programme.desc: En este tenso thriller protagonizado por John Travolta y Kate Bosworth, un equipo de trabajadores de líneas eléctricas de Texas se apresura a instalar kilómetros de cable antes de que una mortal tormenta eléctrica destruya la red eléctrica.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: código sombra
programme.desc: El suspenso no se detiene mientras el recluta de la CIA Ryan queda atrapado en una peligrosa red de intriga y espionaje. Ryan debe pasar de soldado a analista a agente operativo para detener un complot terrorista devastador contra EE. UU.

programme.title: La vigilante del futuro
programme.desc: Major (Scarlett Johansson) es la primera de su clase: Una mente humana dentro de un cuerpo artificial. Al descubrir que sus creadores mintieron sobre su pasado para controlarla, no se detendrá hasta revelar su verdadera identidad y vengarse.

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: código sombra
programme.desc: El suspenso no se detiene mientras el recluta de la CIA Ryan queda atrapado en una peligrosa red de intriga y espionaje. Ryan debe pasar de soldado a analista a agente operativo para detener un complot terrorista devastador contra EE. UU.

programme.title: Tell en español
programme.desc: Un ladrón de poca monta logra robar un millón de dólares y traiciona a sus cómplices. Ahora deberá escapar de policías corruptos, sus antiguos socios, su oficial de libertad condicional e incluso de su esposa, todos decididos a quedarse con el dinero.

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: Cine Friki
programme.desc: Lo mejor del cine de acción y ciencia ficción: catástrofes, criaturas y combates.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA que sufre un trastorno de estrés postraumático debe proteger a su familia de un ataque a su casa después de que un delincuente convicto y sus secuaces vengan a buscar su alijo de millones dentro de la casa del agente.

programme.title: Truth or Die
programme.desc: Un millonario ha sido brutalmente asesinado en su casa y se han llevado un valioso maletín de la caja de seguridad. Cuando el guardaespaldas del millonario regresa a la escena del crimen, se encuentra con tres testigos-sospechosos: el hijo del millonario, una joven aparentemente dulce y un mago bohemio. Los tres relatan las escenas del asesinato desde puntos de vista opuestos, cada uno con una versión diferente de quién cometió el crimen.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Después de devorar a la población de peces, miles de lampreas hambrientas comienzan a atacar a los ciudadanos de una tranquila ciudad lacustre, y la comunidad lucha por mantenerse con vida.

programme.title: Thor: god of thunder (esp)
programme.desc: Loki, el malvado tío de Thor, ha escapado de Asgard en busca de Yggdrasil, el Árbol de los Nueve Reinos, un árbol que contiene el poder del universo y que está oculto en la Tierra.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Fast and Fierce: Death Race
programme.desc: Jack Tyson es un joven que participa en una carrera automovilística ilegal de México a California cuando una mujer desesperada, que huye de su abusivo novio gánster que financia el torneo, se sube a su coche pidiendo su ayuda y tiene una unidad USB incriminatoria que podría enviar a su novio matón, entre otros, a prisión.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim, un neoyorquino corriente, vive con una esposa enferma pero cariñosa. De repente, todo cambia cuando la economía se hunde y lo pierde todo. Lleno de ira y rabia, Jim se propone vengarse de la vida que le han arrebatado.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: El agresor
programme.desc: Sasha Mitchell (Kickboxer 2 y 3) regresa triunfalmente al ring como David Sloan, luchando no solo por su supervivencia, sino también por su bella esposa, quien se ha convertido en la prisionera sexual del despreciable campeón mundial, Tong Po. Incriminado, olvidado y furioso, Sloan se ha consumido en prisión, pero los federales acceden a liberarlo si logra entrar en la impenetrable fortaleza mexicana de Tong Po, protegida por sus letales guardias y adornada por sus esclavas sexuales. Sloan no tiene más remedio que participar en el torneo de campeones de Po, una batalla salvaje donde el ganador se lo lleva todo, ¡y para Sloan eso significa todo! A regañadientes, forma alianzas con algunos otros para ayudarlo.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio en Los Ángeles y luego uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Batalla de las Ardenas: Guerra de Invierno
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, los alemanes deciden lanzar una última gran ofensiva. Al teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón se les asigna la responsabilidad de defender un depósito de suministros vital.

programme.title: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Faith está orgullosa de ser por fin policía en su ciudad natal de Stillwater, Oklahoma. Se une a Paul, su antiguo amor, en el cuerpo de policía y se preocupa cuando él se involucra sentimentalmente con Jessica, una belleza errática con un pasado criminal. Entonces, cuando Jessica tiene una aventura con un joven impresionable, Faith debe construir un caso contra Jessica antes de que Jessica destruya la vida de Paul.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee

programme.title: Buffalo soldiers
programme.desc: 1989. El muro de Berlín está a punto de caer y el planeta va a convertirse en un lugar seguro según un nuevo orden mundial. El especialista Ray Elwood, en la Base del ejército norteamericano, está a punto de comprobar cómo su particular guerra fría se pone al rojo vivo. programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

Con suficientes giros inesperados, KILL'EM ALL te mantendrá en vilo hasta el último disparo.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Arenas movedizas
programme.desc: En este thriller negro, un banquero de carácter introvertido y trabajador se ve envuelto en una serie de eventos que incluyen un asesinato y una trama de chantaje, todo mientras intenta mantener su vida en orden.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: Me case con un desconocido
programme.desc: Emma y David acaban de casarse. Durante su luna de miel, la joven es atacada salvajemente. Su extraño comportamiento y su negativa a cooperar hacen que David se convierta rápidamente en el principal sospechoso. Emma rechaza esta sugerencia, pero empieza a tener dudas: ¿conoce realmente al hombre con el que se ha casado?

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: Eye of the beast: El monstruo del lago

programme.desc: Samuel, un hombre que vive en los Alpes italianos, decide ayudar a Chehreh, una mujer afgana, a llegar a Francia. Tendrán que enfrentarse a una naturaleza hostil y a la crueldad de los hombres que habitan este territorio.

programme.title: Boost
programme.desc: Cuando Jimmy encuentra un paquete misterioso en el maletero del último coche que roba, se ve envuelto en un violento mundo criminal y en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar la vida de una niña.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

programme.desc: While hiking with husband Dennis in Montana, Leslee Larson fell into Wolf Creek. Then Dennis is convicted of murdering his wife, while in Main. And 15-year-old papergirl Penny Parker goes missing, then her body is found by a search volunteer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A videotape made at an ATM machine helps police in Louisville, KY, to nab a man suspected of raping 13 women. And a DA investigator in Georgia helps crack a murder case that his father, a police chief, first worked on 30 years before.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A police investigator discovers a letter written 16 years earlier that provides clues to a woman's murder. And a firearms expert supplies the evidence that South Carolina authorities need to put a man on trial in 2002 for a murder committed in 1961.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.desc: Un espacio de oración y reflexión espirital a través de la interpretación de la Palabra de Cristo. A través del programa, el público podrá reencontrarse con la calidez de Dios y de sus Sagradas Enseñanzas.

programme.title: Al taller
programme.desc: Taller de formación en temas referentes a la iglesia que contribuye a nuestras vidas y a nuestra fe, con un lenguaje sencillo que permita el fácil entendimiento de estos temas.

programme.title: Novena al Señor de los Milagros
Taller de oración
programme.desc: A través del evangelio se busca que las personas aprendan diferentes maneras de orar y meditar para su encuentro con el Señor.

programme.title: Liturgia de las horas - Completas
programme.desc: Un espacio de contenido religioso para reflexionar y conectar con la fe y la espiritualidad.

programme.title: El escándalo de envejecer
programme.desc: Un programa que aborda los mitos, temores y realidades que rodean a la vejez en la sociedad actual.

programme.title: Llena tu día de Dios
programme.desc: Basados en la lectura del día, se realiza una reflexión para que los Cristovidentes comiencen con energía y vitalidad sus mañanas.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The whole team must investigate a crime where a husband and his porn star wife were murdered execution-style.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Catherine and Sara deal with the death of what at first seems to be a transvestite.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A mutilated female body is discovered tied to the undercarriage of a bus carrying prisoners from a women's correctional facility after a severed arm flies out from beneath the vehicle and strikes a car.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A violent murder in a casino parking garage and another episode in the police interview room lead the CSIs to one shocking discovery after another.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Warrick, Catherine, and Nick try to determine the cause of a house fire that kills a teenage girl. The fire is in the same neighborhood as a similar arson fire. Grissom and Sara investigate a man found dead with letter tiles in his stomach.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom, Catherine, and Nick investigate the death of a runner during a competition. Meanwhile, Sara and Warrick investigate the death of a couple in a hotel room, initially thought to be a murder-suicide.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: While Grissom leads a group of college students on a tour of CSI, the dead speak while the CSIs investigate, each narrating their own case

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The CSIs investigate first-hand the behind-the-scenes action of Cirque du Soleil in order to determine what may have contributed to a young dancer's untimely death.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom is fascinated when every detail of a miniature is identical to that of a real crime scene, and he goes about trying to solve the case using the clues provided.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un hombre (Alan Rosenberg) con el que Catherine flirteó en un bar reaparece en su vida como sospechoso en la investigación del asesinato de una mujer a la que dispararon y mataron.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Dos amorosos estudiantes de primer año son encontrados muertos en un saco de dormir en un dormitorio, y Sara y Greg se topan con un callejón sin salida tras otro mientras intentan determinar por qué fueron asesinados los estudiantes.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Los equipos de CSI se unen para salvar a uno de los suyos cuando se enteran de que un miembro del equipo ha sido secuestrado y enterrado vivo, y ahora deben encontrarlo antes de que se asfixie bajo metro y medio de tierra.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Los equipos de CSI se unen para salvar a uno de los suyos cuando se enteran de que un miembro del equipo ha sido secuestrado y enterrado vivo, y ahora deben encontrarlo antes de que se asfixie bajo metro y medio de tierra.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Nuestro equipo forense vuelve a estar unido, con Grissom y Catherine liderando tres fantásticos misterios forenses.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una estrella de cine es encontrada muerta en su habitación de hotel después de una fiesta, mientras que un taxista muerto lleva al equipo a una serie de muertes que involucran a trabajadores inmigrantes.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Nuestro grupo de investigación de crímenes intenta determinar si hubo juego sucio en la caída de un ama de casa por las escaleras.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un robo en medio de la noche, en una casa suburbana al borde del desierto de Las Vegas, revela un vertedero de cadáveres.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una familia de 4, es brutalmente asesinada en su propia casa.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: CSI determina que el suicidio de una joven madre fue en realidad un juego sucio.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una parada de tráfico de rutina se convierte en una salvaje persecución policial por las calles de un gueto latino de Las Vegas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: La evidencia apunta a Sofía como la que disparó accidentalmente a otro oficial.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: En la noche de "Acción de Gracias," un hombre es encontrado muerto en un contenedor de basura detrás de un restaurante.

programme.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
programme.desc: In County Durham, heli-medics battle to keep Mick alive after a massive seizure twelve-year-old Ollie faces a limb-threatening injury at the motocross track in the Yorkshire Dales there's a dramatic hillside rescue for paraglider Alastair.

programme.title: Fight to Survive
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

programme.title: Fight to Survive
programme.desc: When avid bow hunter, Dr. Joe Baumgartner sets out to do routine maintenance on his tree stands, a twenty-two foot fall leaves him with a severely broken leg and miles from help in the deep Mississippi woods.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sanity.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Friends and Neighbors
programme.desc: Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission, to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Set-Up
programme.desc: The trail is hot and the stakes is high for Dog and the posse. The "Big Fish" in this case is Marco, an alleged drug dealer with a big bond. But a major key to catching him is Elizabeth, who is also a fugitive from the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Searchers
programme.desc: Dog is still on the search for the elusive fugitive, Marco. Dog has been tracking him across Colorado, from Grand Junction to Denver, and now a hot tip that a long time associate of his is hiding in Pueblo sends the team racing south.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Buddha's Delight
programme.desc: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Three's Company
programme.desc: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district, moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Strip Search
programme.desc: When a stripper goes on the lam, Dog has to bring her in. It's a tough job but somebody has to do it. Thankfully for the team, Lady Luck is presiding over the posse tonight.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Secret Places
programme.desc: When Leland learns that one of his clients with a reputation for stealing has lost her co-signer and could be ready to run, Dog and the crew hop a plane to the Big Island.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Dog's target today seems to have a taste for drugs and a record of reckless driving. The hunt has deep emotional resonance for the team because today is the anniversary of the fatal car accident of Dog's daughter Barbara Katie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Rider
programme.desc: What looks like a routine pick-up turns into a complicated case of betrayal, deceit, as well as quality nail care as Dog and company track down a fugitive alleged to be an abusive boyfriend with one too many friends in his close knit community.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Midnight Run
programme.desc: This fugitive has a bad reputation and a knack for running from the law. The pursuit has Dog and team traveling through an urban dystopia of suspicion, false leads and mistrust.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Hunt for Santa
programme.desc: Dog decides he needs to help his son Garry believe in Santa Claus again. So now the Dog, with a posse expanded to include his children and grandchildren, sets off on a hunt through the Colorado Rockies for Santa Claus himself!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Call Waiting
programme.desc: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Kid Stuff
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Easy Does It
programme.desc: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive, he always promises them it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back in the Hood
programme.desc: Today, Dog's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills to track his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Road
programme.desc: Dog is a big-hearted guy. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out. He's also giving his nephew Justin a second chance to rejoin the team.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon, Dog knows that someone is being deceived. The only question is, whom?

programme.desc: As a mother of seven, Chelle T has seen it all, and shes not afraid to joke about it. programme.title: Dave Burleigh
programme.desc: Comedian and Impressionist Dave Burleigh's star is on the rise. His uncanny ability to impersonate just about anyone landed him the starring role as Charlie Sheen in "Not Another Celebrity Movie." Burleigh's multiple characters, voices, and impressions were showcased on Season 7 of America's Got Talent, where he became a fast favorite of both judges and fans alike. Judge Howard Stern said, "You have an excellent command of the stage." Fellow comedian and judge Howie Mandel added, "Your impressions were spot on." Burleigh's laid back and easy going style and persona on stage contrasted with his unique facial and body expressions are guaranteed to leave audiences amazed and impressed. As a two-time finalist in the San Francisco Comedy Competition, Burleigh now shares the first runner-up spot with past participant comedy legends like Robin Williams, Ellen DeGeneres, Marc Maron, Dane Cook and Kevin Pollak. With numerous television, podcast and radio appearances, prestigious publications like Rolling Stone are talking, "Burleigh has the trappings of a soon to be comedy star!" This talented, singer, musician, actor, comedian and host tours the world over 36 weeks a year and headlines all the major casinos in Las Vegas. Make sure to catch Dave's show at a theater or comedy club near you, as he will no doubt, leave you with a lasting impression.

programme.title: Tom Mabe
programme.desc: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post. He's been featured on radio shows from Hollywood to Dollywood, including "Bob&Tom", Johnboy & Billy "BillHandel" and "Drew&Mike". Chances are you also know Tom as the star of CMT's hit comedy series, "Mabe in America", or have watched one of his popular viral videos. With more than 50-million views on YouTube, Tom is one of the most downloaded people on the planet. People love Tom's stories about coping with life's challenges, ranging from a child with a microscopic attention span to a family vacation in a minivan that takes a wrong turn. His original songs, stories, and videos make for a night out you will remember for years.

programme.title: Rodney Norman: You Have To Stay Focused
programme.desc: Rodney Norman will keep you laughing with his hysterical insights into his daily journey into understanding the world. Rodney makes the simple things in life seem complex and strange and the complex and strange seem normal and common place. He has entertained audiences around the US with his unique point of view. Winner of the Rhode Island Comedy Festival and has been featured at the Boston Comedy Festival. From raising kids, serving in the Marine Corps, and Studying philosophy Rodney has a little bit of everything for everybody. His style is inviting, captivating, smart, and clean.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Scoot Along Si
programme.desc: Si shows up to work on a mobility scooter, claiming to have an invisible injury from a fender bender with Willie. After losing her beloved turtle "Mr. T", Ms. Kay enlists Phil on a mission to find a new pet turtle.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jerky Boys
programme.desc: A decision to try and make some duck jerky leads the boys to Godwin's garage and a minibike race. Phil and Kay have made Willie the executor of their will, and Phil wants to show Willie what he and his brothers will inherit when he and Kay pass away.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Going Si-ral
programme.desc: Si discovers Youtube, and, after watching a series of instructional videos, decides he can make something better. John Luke totals Willie's truck, and Willie realizes he may be raising the two worst drivers in all of Louisiana.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack-O-Lantern
programme.desc: The Robertsons host a Halloween event at Duck Commander, where they all come together to transform the warehouse into a "scarehouse." Everyone dresses up and Willie desperately tries to be the scariest, but none of the kids are afraid of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.sub-title: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.desc: The Robertsons perform a live nativity for their Church for Christmas, so the wives organize rehearsals to ensure that they pull off a great event. However, rehearsals get off to a bumpy start as the guys can't stop sharing their opinions.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Boomerang Becca
programme.desc: When Rebecca returns home from her internship in Los Angeles, the Robertson family plans a big surprise party to welcome her back. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si gets sick, he seeks the help of Ms. Kay to take care of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie's Number Two
programme.desc: When Willie is looking to hire a new assistant, Korie insists he interviews her cousin, JD. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si spends the day over at Phil and Kay's, Jep stops by with the kids to keep them away from Jessica, who has taken ill.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Life of Si
programme.desc: After seeing footage Jep shot using a GoPro, Si decides he wants to use the camera to record a day in his life. But when Si gets on the guys nerves while they're hunting, they kick him and his GoPros out of the blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: From Duck 'til Dawn
programme.desc: When the duck guys have to pull an all-nighter to finish some work, Willie decides he wants to join them. But when a dying smoke detector distracts them from their work, Jase and Willie head off to disarm it.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Burger Commander
programme.desc: After visiting a popular burger restaurant, Willie and Jase get into a debate over which of them cooks the best burger, prompting them to challenge one another to a cooking contest.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: G.I. Si
programme.desc: When Willie and Jase argue over an old G.I. Joe toy, it leads them into a debate over who would make a better soldier. To settle the score, Willie and Jase head out to the woods with their friends and children for a paintball match.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jase and the Argonauts
programme.desc: When Willie gets a soft serve machine for himself, he tells the guys they can't use it until they're done working. But when Jase thinks this is unfair, he takes matters into his own hands and finds a better object to use as motivation.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fowl Playhouse
programme.desc: When Jase finds out Jep is planning to buy his kids a fancy playhouse from a catalogue, he and the guys decide to build one for Jep themselves. But the playhouse ends up looking more like a military-style duck blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Big LeCOWski
programme.desc: When Sadie spends the day at Duck Commander for a school project, the guys try to show her the ins-and-outs of how a successful company works. But when Willie questions Jase's ingenuity in creating new products they get into a debate.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: The Robertson family pulls together a family reunion to give Mia a big send-off before her surgery.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Governor's Travels
programme.desc: When the Governor of Louisiana announces that he will be coming to Duck Commander to present Willie with a commerce award, John Luke volunteers to give the introduction speech.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack and Gown
programme.desc: With Reed's graduation day approaching, Jase decides to take Reed frog hunting the night before, like he did on the day of his own graduation. Willie and Si join in, and Jase tries to keep them from imparting their "college advice" on Reed.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hands on a Woodchipper
programme.desc: When Willie agrees to sponsor Mountain Man's radio contest, a "Hands on a Hardbody" competition, he somehow finds himself competing against Si for Mountain Man's last minute prize: a woodchipper.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack Draft
programme.desc: When the Robertsons participate in the West Monroe Fire Department pancake breakfast, the firemen invite Willie and his brothers to train with the department for the day. Meanwhile, Phil and Si accompany Miss Kay on a trip to visit a family grave.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Brand of Brothers
programme.desc: When Willie contemplates re-branding the Duck Commander image, Jase takes issue with having an outsider design their image, so he and the guys create their own new logo and business cards. Meanwhile, Willie and Phil help Bella with her science project.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: De-Bug Life
programme.desc: The guys realize it is time for the annual cleaning of the duck blinds when they come across a gator using one as a home. Meanwhile, while the kids are running the church car wash, Si and Willie disagree on the best way to draw in customers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Men vs. Wild
programme.desc: Brotherly competition is taken to a whole new level when Jase and Willie challenge Alan and Jep to a survival race through the woods on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Si is interested in finding a new hobby when he sees Kay cutting coupons.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Return of the Beavers
programme.desc: When Phil discovers more beaver activity on the Robertson land, he recruits Jase, Jep, and Si to get rid of them. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie bring Bella to her first day of karate practice.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Stumped on a way to celebrate Willie's birthday, Korie enlists the guys' help and Jase takes the reigns in planning a trip to the lake where Phil and Kay used to live. Meanwhile, the women realize a raccoon is inside the lake house.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard
programme.sub-title: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard
programme.desc: When Willie takes a business trip to Scotland to expand his duck call business, he brings the entire family along so they can reconnect with their Scottish roots. Willie organizes a bus tour to trace his family heritage.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Night and Good Duck
programme.desc: A special holiday episode of Duck Dynasty shows when the Robertson family took over the Thanksgiving special of a local TV show "Good Morning Arklamiss." Each family member presents a special holiday segment, with Willie and Jase serving as anchormen.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack in the Saddle
programme.desc: When Willie becomes the temporary owner of a thoroughbred, he and the guys take it to a local track and enter it into a race. Meanwhile, when Kay decides she wants to buy a new birdbath for her yard, she recruits Phil, Martin and Godwin.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Después de todo lo vivido en 7 vidas, sitcom de la que nace esta serie, Sole (Amparo Baró) llega a Esperanza Sur para visitar a su amiga Aída (Carmen Machi). Sole se encuentra en el bar Reinols cuando Mauricio (Mariano Peña) le echa una gran reprimenda a uno de sus camareros. Debido a una mala interpretación, Sole cree que el hostelero ha matado a su empleado y decide avisar a la policía Por su parte, Luisma (Paco León) recibe inesperadamente una gran cantidad de dinero que decide derrochar con su madre, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso). Cuando el banco comunica el error, Luisma tiene que devolver el dinero. Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) quiere que Paz (Melanie Olivares) pose desnuda. Cuando Jonathan (David Castillo) se entera, no dudará en aprovechar la situación y sacarle partido económico con sus amigos.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) quiere someterse a una operación de aumento de pecho. En esta importante decisión, cuenta con el apoyo de Paz (Melanie Olivares) pero con la desaprobación de su hermana mayor, Soraya (Miren Ibaguren). Aidita (Sanseverina) no puede dormir porque ha perdido su peluche, así que su bisabuela, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) decide sustituir el peluche por el muñeco de Spiderman de Jonathan (David Castillo), lo que causa una sorprendente reacción en el chico. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) decide contratar en su tienda a un vagabundo víctima de la grosería de Mauricio (Mariano Peña).

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Chema es acosado por una clienta que le pide constantemente acostarse con él y cuando se lo cuenta a Simón, éste va a intentar beneficiarse de la situación. programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Paz organiza una doble cita con Simón y su amiga Claudia esperando que su hermano aparezca con Luisma pero resulta que invita a Barajas. programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un número muy feo, una urraca a la fuga y un cordero por mensajero
programme.desc: Patricia, la asistente social, les concede a Amador y Maite el deseo de pasar unas Navidades inolvidables juntos con sus hijos. Además, Justi y Teodoro, la madre y el hermano de Amador, se presentan en Montepinar para pasar estas fechas con los Cuquis. Mientras, Fermín decide comprar Lotería de Navidad para todos los vecinos para subir su popularidad como vicepresidente. Al ver que la mayoría le ignora, decide ofrecérselos a otros interesados, como Chus, la exnovia de Coque que sueña con reinsertarse en la sociedad. Enrique y Judith, por su parte, rivalizan por acaparar el cariño de su hijo Dylan comprándole un montón de regalos por Navidad.
